# A pre-Skylake Intel GPU on the LEGACY i965 driver that DOES advertise VP9 -- the
# case that motivated the i965 rule in effective().
#
# NOT captured: no machine here serves VP9 through i965. It is constructed from the
# i965 driver's real profile list for such parts (Broadwell hybrid VP9), because the
# point being tested is the DECISION, not the hardware: with i965 answering, `auto`
# must pick H.264 even though VAProfileVP9Profile0 is advertised as VLD -- the i965
# VP9 is hybrid, part of the work stays on the CPU, which the user reported for
# their Devil's Canyon.
#
# The captured counterpart is vainfo-iris-xe.txt (iHD, full VP9 + AV1).
